name: 3D Scene Plausibility Benchmark
description: A dataset and evaluation benchmark for assessing the plausibility of reconstructed or synthetic 3D scenes.
evaluation_method: accuracy for binary plausibility labels plus human preference/evaluation for subjective plausibility judgments
general_score_metric: accuracy (plausibility classification) and human preference rate
reputation: Emerging dataset in the 3D vision community with limited but growing adoption for evaluating scene reconstruction and synthesis plausibility.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark requiring 3D assets and rendering; subjectivity in human labels can introduce noise; results depend on renderer and dataset scale; may require significant compute for evaluation.
